cover.headline: 12 stories in 5 minutes. Israel has no majority, Dnipro station hit, Lagarde to quit the ECB.

stories.head: Drone hits Dnipro station as truce opens
body: A drone struck a crowded platform at Dnipro's main station, killing at least 14 and injuring 10. Zelensky put the day's toll at 19.
A six-day truce began around Oleshky in Kherson. The Kremlin warns strikes on Nov. 4 could jeopardize Abu Dhabi talks.

stories.head: Vance letter to Tehran, $47bn war bill
body: US media say Vance sent Iran's security chief a letter via Qatar proposing talks. Trump says it was about medical supplies, and told Gulf allies to prepare for action after Nov. 3.
The Pentagon says the war has cost at least $47.1bn. It acknowledges 18 US deaths.

stories.head: ECB holds, Lagarde to leave early
body: The ECB held its rate at 2.5% with inflation at 3.8%. Lagarde will step down on Feb. 7, 2027, nine months early.
France pays about 5% on 10-year debt. Alphabet fell about 10% after hours, and Brent is near $110.

stories.head: Israel has no majority, Bolsonaro in Miami
body: Israel: Netanyahu's bloc has 53 seats, the Eisenkot-led bloc 48, Arab-led parties 19. A majority needs 61.
Brazil: Flavio Bolsonaro flew to Miami after losing to Lula by over 4 million votes and alleged fraud without evidence.

stories.head: Spain toll, Bosnia crash, Ethiopia, Albania
body: Spain: train crash toll revised to 69. Bosnia: an Italian EUFOR Chinook crashed near Brcko, with 3 to 4 dead.
Ethiopia: Su-35 jets and S-400s from Russia. Albania: opposition lit flares in parliament. West Bank: 5 Italian activists detained.
